# Best OutDoor Wears

> Free, original guides on outdoor clothing layering, camping and hiking packing lists, and wilderness survival basics — plus TrailReady, a $19 printable kit (layering guide, conditions-helper spreadsheet, and an 89-card survival skills deck).

All guides are written in-house, dated, and updated when revised. No affiliate content, no sponsored placements, no fabricated reviews or statistics. Content that cannot be verified is stated as such rather than guessed.

## Product

- [TrailReady](/product/): the combined kit — layering guide, conditions-helper spreadsheet, and 89-card survival deck. $19, instant download, non-refundable (see /terms/).

## Free resources

- [Printable camping checklist](/camping-checklist/): 50-item list, free PDF with real fillable checkboxes, no email required.
